compiled.cypher: UNWIND $arg_component_ids AS seed_id MATCH (n0:KREntity {generation_key:$scope_key,canonical_id:seed_id}) WHERE n0.kind=$seed_kind WITH DISTINCT n0 ORDER BY n0.canonical_id LIMIT $seed_limit WITH collect(n0) AS seeds UNWIND CASE WHEN size(seeds)=0 THEN [null] ELSE seeds END AS n0 CALL { WITH n0 MATCH (n0)<-[r0:KR_LINK]-(n1:KREntity {generation_key:$scope_key}) WHERE r0.generation_key=$scope_key AND r0.edge_type=$step_0_edge AND n1.kind=$step_0_kind WITH DISTINCT n1 ORDER BY n1.canonical_id LIMIT $probe_fanout RETURN collect(n1) AS hits0 } WITH *, size(hits0)>$fanout AS clipped0 UNWIND CASE WHEN size(hits0)=0 THEN [null] ELSE hits0[..$fanout] END AS n1 CALL { WITH n1 MATCH (n1)-[r1:KR_LINK]->(n2:KREntity {generation_key:$scope_key}) WHERE r1.generation_key=$scope_key AND r1.edge_type=$step_1_edge AND n2.kind=$step_1_kind WITH DISTINCT n2 ORDER BY n2.canonical_id LIMIT $probe_fanout RETURN collect(n2) AS hits1 } WITH *, size(hits1)>$fanout AS clipped1 UNWIND CASE WHEN size(hits1)=0 THEN [null] ELSE hits1[..$fanout] END AS n2 WITH n2, max(CASE WHEN clipped0 OR clipped1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clipped ORDER BY n2.canonical_id WITH collect(n2) AS found, max(clipped) AS clipped RETURN [n IN found[..$result_limit] | n.payload] AS payloads, (clipped=1 OR size(found)>$result_limit) AS expansion_truncated
